svg.title: Appointment Tracking System — Updated UML Domain Model

g.text: Appointment Tracking System — Updated UML Domain Model
Preferences: professional, specialty or date range.
Staff edits priority; offers follow highest priority first.
Booking names the exact entry; other entries are unchanged.
Decline alone does not remove or exclude the patient.
An offer records contact, not a capacity reservation.
Resources are predefined; assisting roles are capacity pools, not named personnel.
Specific rooms/equipment have capacity 1; a role pool has its predefined capacity.
Each allocation equals the service requirement quantity for that resource.
At every instant, total active allocated quantity must not exceed capacity.
Two specific rooms: two requirements of 1; two nurses: one role requirement of 2.
Generated from a schedule or imported as one-off availability.
status : requested / confirmed / rescheduled / cancelled / completed
status : waiting / offered / accepted / declined / removed
